#1003 [decision] fix-slugify-diacritics proposal

# Proposal: fix-slugify-diacritics

## ASSUMED ANSWERs (unattended run, no questions asked)
- Approach: A (NFD, strip combining marks, NFC, then existing pipeline).
- No new dependencies. ASCII output unchanged. Non-Latin letters kept as today.
- Scope: slugify only. Risk tolerance: conservative. Gate auto-approved.

## Intent
slugify('Crème Brûlée') returns 'crème-brûlée' because src/slugify.js line 10 (/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu) keeps accented letters as \p{L}. URL slugs should fold Latin diacritics to base letters ('creme-brulee').

## Scope - In
- In src/slugify.js: after toLowerCase/trim, apply str.normalize('NFD'), remove combining diacritical marks, then normalize('NFC'), then the existing replace pipeline.
- Strip only the Combining Diacritical Marks block (/[̀-ͯ]/g), NOT all \p{M}. Stripping all \p{M} would corrupt non-Latin scripts whose vowel signs or marks are \p{M} (Devanagari, Thai, Arabic harakat). The final NFC recomposes any non-Latin sequences that NFD decomposed (e.g. Hangul), so non-Latin output stays identical to today.
- New tests in test/slugify.test.js: 'Crème Brûlée' -> 'creme-brulee'; 'Åñö' -> 'ano'; already-decomposed input; non-Latin unchanged (e.g. Cyrillic 'Привет мир', Hangul); ASCII regression (existing 3 tests).
- README.md slugify note, if it describes behavior.

## Scope - Out
- Transliteration of non-Latin scripts; folding of ligatures/special letters (ß, æ, ø, đ, ł do not decompose under NFD and remain as-is); new dependencies (e.g. slugify, diacritics libs); options/API changes; other textkit functions; src/index.js exports.

## Approach
Add a normalization step before the existing regex. Single-line pipeline change, no signature change. Details (constant naming, regex literal) are left to Design.

## Affected Areas
- /private/tmp/e-EiNRe9/home/cwd/src/slugify.js (modify)
- /private/tmp/e-EiNRe9/home/cwd/test/slugify.test.js (add tests)
- /private/tmp/e-EiNRe9/home/cwd/README.md (possible doc line)
- src/index.js: re-export only, no

# Spec: fix-slugify-diacritics

Target: slugify(str) in src/slugify.js. Signature, exports, dependencies unchanged.

## ADDED

**REQ-001:** slugify MUST fold Latin letters carrying diacritics (combining marks U+0300-U+036F after NFD) to their base letters.
- S1 precomposed: Given 'Crème Brûlée' When slugify Then 'creme-brulee'.
- S2 multiple marks: Given 'Åñö' When slugify Then 'ano'.
- S3 uppercase accented: Given 'ÉCOLE Élémentaire' When slugify Then 'ecole-elementaire'.
- S4 accent within punctuation: Given '  Café, Crème & Thé!  ' When slugify Then 'cafe-creme-the'.

**REQ-002:** slugify MUST give identical output for NFD-decomposed and NFC-precomposed input.
- S1 Given 'Crème Brûlée' (decomposed) When slugify Then 'creme-brulee' and equals slugify('Crème Brûlée').
- S2 Given 'Åñö' When slugify Then 'ano'.
- S3 stray mark: Given a string consisting only of '́' When slugify Then ''.

**REQ-003:** slugify MUST NOT alter output for non-Latin scripts (output identical to pre-change behavior); only the U+0300-U+036F range is stripped, not all \p{M}, and NFC recomposition MUST restore sequences NFD decomposed.
- S1 Cyrillic: Given 'Привет мир' When slugify Then 'привет-мир'.
- S2 Hangul: Given '안녕 세계' When slugify Then '안녕-세계' (jamo recomposed by NFC).
- S3 non-range marks preserved: Given input with a \p{M} mark outside U+0300-U+036F (e.g. Devanagari 'हिन्दी') When slugify Then the output equals the pre-change output (marks not stripped by the new step).

**REQ-004:** Letters that do not decompose under NFD (ß, æ, ø, đ, ł) MUST remain as-is (no transliteration); slugs may contain them.
- S1 Given 'Straße' When slugify Then 'straße'.
- S2 Given 'Øresund Łódź' When slugify Then 'øresund-łodz' (Ł/ø kept lowercased; ó/ź folded to o/z).
